{{Quote|I'm not ''leaving'' this jungle-infested planet without them-- even if we have to ''ray-blast'' them!|Imperial commander|<ref name="DYKWYCA">''[[Do You Know What Your Children Are?]]''</ref>}}
An '''unidentified Imperial commander''' led a fleet of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and later a team of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] during the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]].

==Biography==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] commanded a fleet of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in the [[Keeper's World system/Legends|Keeper's World system]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. When a [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy trooper]] detected an unmarked [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|starship]] refusing to identify itself, the commander rightly surmised that it was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] craft and ordered its capture. He did not know the vessel was crewed by the heroes of the Rebellion, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The Rebel ship escaped the Imperial [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]], but was so damaged that it crashed on the nearby [[Keeper's World]].<ref name="UPSWS2" /> The commander took a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and a single [[Unidentified Imperial fighter craft|landing craft]] and gave pursuit.<ref name="DD">{{StoryCite|story=Dread Discovery!|book=Pizzazz 3}}</ref>

The commander discovered the Rebels had fled the wreckage of their ship, and pursued them. Because of the droids the Rebels' speed was hampered, and the commander and his Stormtroopers were able to corner them in the ruins of an [[Keeper's Temple|ancient temple]]. When the commander gave them an opportunity to surrender the Rebels managed to activate a [[teleportal]], teleporting them inside the caverns within.<ref name="PATR" /> The commander soon discovered how to activate the teleportal himself, but was surprised to find the Rebels had new allies, the strange androids who could control the elements of [[Earth (droid)|Earth]], [[Fire (individual)|Fire]], [[Rain (droid)|Rain]], and [[Wind (android)|Wind]]. The elemental onslaught forced the commander and his Stormtroopers to take cover. By the time they emerged the Rebels and the androids had fled.<ref name="COM">{{StoryCite|story=Caverns of Mystery!|book=Pizzazz 7}}</ref>

Giving pursuit once again, the commander used [[heat detector]]s to track the Rebels. Having tracked them to a cavernous chamber, the commander and his Stormtroopers witnessed that chamber destroyed in an explosion as the planet became dangerously unstable. Assured that the Rebels could not have survived, the commander ordered a retreat from the collapsing caverns.<ref name="TKS">{{StoryCite|story=The Keeper's Secret!|book=Pizzazz 8}}</ref>

What the commander could not know is that the planet was under the control of the ancient computer known as [[The Keeper]]. She had manufactured the planetary upheaval, and stopped the upheaval once the Imperials had withdrawn from the planet. She also protected the Rebels from destruction during the explosion and subsequent cataclysm. Not knowing this, and believing the Rebels dead and the planetary cataclysm natural, the commander returned to his fleet. His intention was to warn [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] that the planet was a deathtrap, and warn all Imperial units away from the planet in the future.<ref name="TFF">{{StoryCite|story=The Final Fury!|book=Pizzazz 9}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Then it must be a ''rebel ship!'' Best if we ''capture'' it, rather than ''destroy'' it.|Imperial commander|<ref name="UPSWS2" />}}
The Imperial commander was in many ways a model of what an Imperial commander should be. He was decisive, barking clear orders to his subordinates, and was equally at home leading Stormtroopers on the ground as he was commanding Star Destroyers in space. He was dogged in his pursuit of Rebels, but not bloodthirsty. If possible he preferred to capture Rebels rather than kill them.<ref name="UPSWS2" /> However, he was not soft-hearted either, and would rather kill Rebels than allow them to escape.<ref name="DYKWYCA" />After multiple frustrations he became more willing to kill, and would order his Stormtroopers to shoot to kill if a pursuit dragged on for too long.<ref name="TKS" /> He was punctual in his reports to Imperial High Command, and secure enough in his authority to send warnings and advisories to all Imperial units.<ref name="TFF" />

If he had one flaw, it was his tendency to assume a likely outcome had actually occurred, as when he assumed the death of the Rebels he was chasing without ensuring their deaths, or simply reporting them as missing.<ref name="TFF" />

He used "fool" as his preferred insult, using it both to describe Rebels,<ref name="TFF" /> and also subordinates who failed to grasp the obvious, like when a [[groundquake]] made a cavern a danger to his men.<ref name="TKS" />
